title: Replace a company or partnership contractor licence
summary: You can order a replacement contractor licence for a company or partnership if the original licence is damaged, lost, or stolen, by visiting a Service NSW Centre.
intro: If your company or partnership holds a contractor licence that has been damaged, lost or stolen, you can order a replacement licence at a Service NSW Centre.
who_can_apply: The company or partnership must hold a contractor licence that has been damaged, lost, or stolen.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit'

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your application in person.

external_links.text: Company and partnership licences – Building Commission NSW
Building, trade and specialist licences and registrations – Building Commission NSW

faqs.q: What do I need to replace a lost or damaged contractor licence?
faqs.a: You will need the 'Application for duplicate licence, certificate or permit' PDF form, details of the licence, and your fee payment.

faqs.q: Where can I submit my application for a replacement licence?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your application in person.
